verdict.rationale: Paychex's own developer API overview lists 'Webhooks' as a documented topic alongside its REST API, so a first-party webhook capability exists. Nothing in the pack describes how to register subscriptions or which events are available. missing for 10: documented event catalog covering payroll processed, employee onboarded and payment failed, subscription/registration mechanics, payload and delivery details (signing, retries), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payroll lifecycle events (payroll processed, employee onboarded, payment failed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations
